## About
Grubbs started as Grubbs Motorsports, founded by Michael Grubbs to build show cars and service classic cars. Along the way we took on a few collision jobs and found that our show quality paint, body lines and gaps made our collision work stand out. Customers kept coming back for it, so Michael built a collision repair center.
Today we treat your car like it's our own. We only fix what needs to be fixed, and we tell you how we're going to treat your vehicle before we get started. If you have questions, go ahead and ask. We're here to listen.
You'll find us on Buckingham in Garland, with gated parking and camera surveillance throughout. Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 59 Google reviews.

## Services
- Complete collision repair: Whether it's a refresh or a nasty scratch, we inspect the car with you to figure out the paint and work needed for the result you want.
- Paintless dent repair: When a dent qualifies, fixing it without repainting the panel can cost less. Creased dents or paint damage usually call for conventional body work.
- Aluminum body repair: Aluminum panels need careful heating, reforming and cooling. We have the monitoring and specialized tools to do it right.
- Frame measuring and straightening: Our hydraulic frame machine pulls a damaged frame back to factory specifications.
- Sheet metal repair and replacement: Sometimes repairing a panel is best for your car. If we can't get it right, we'll tell you and suggest replacement.
- Structural chassis replacement and repair: Major and minor collisions can both damage a vehicle's underlying structure. We'll tell you whether it can be repaired or needs replacing.
- Fleet collision repair: Your trucks and vans carry your brand around town. We help keep them looking their best.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance agencies, and our priority is you, the customer. We work for you and not the insurance company.

Q: I'm paying out of pocket. Can I get an estimate?
A: Yes. We offer free estimates for self pay accidents.

Q: Do you guarantee your repairs?
A: Yes. We guarantee each and every repair.
